[[File:YZ_3000_tanker.jpg|thumb|Sando 7]]
'''Sando 7''' was an [[YZ 3000 tanker]] used to haul [[Water/Legends|water]] from [[Da Soocha]] to its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Napdu]]. In [[137 ABY]] it was used by [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] in an operation to smuggle [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
